quarterly_data.signal: Half-year report (consolidated): Q2 2026 revenue KRW 46,801,507,514 vs KRW 27,844,712,795 in Q2 2025; operating loss KRW 11,038,068,317 vs KRW 13,972,113,161. H1 2026 revenue KRW 94,676,403,790 (H1 2025 KRW 48,061,144,213) and operating loss KRW 10,933,014,058 (H1 2025 loss KRW 28,111,614,692). quarterly_data.signal: Order intake and backlog: consolidated new orders for 01-01-2026 to 06-30-2026 were about KRW 120 billion and the order backlog about KRW 140 billion. Disclosed H1 contracts: a KRW 9,900 million fully-homomorphic-encryption accelerator chip design and prototype supply contract with Niobium Microsystems (term 2026-01-06 to 2027-08-13); a KRW 12,224 million AI NPU ASIC design, development and supply contract with an undisclosed AI chip company (to 2027-12-31, including KRW 5,854 million conditional); and a KRW 14,733 million AI ASIC design-development contract with an undisclosed AI chip company (2026-01-27 to 2027-08-15).
quarterly_data.figure: H1'26 new orders approx. KRW 120 billion; backlog approx. KRW 140 billion; contracts KRW 9,900 million (Niobium), KRW 12,224 million and KRW 14,733 million

quarterly_data.signal: Revenue mix, H1 2026: parent ASIC business split into development/engineering services KRW 54,123,912 thousand (87%) and mass-production product sales KRW 8,002,560 thousand (13%; Q2 product sales KRW 4,497,494 thousand). Consolidated revenue by region: Korea KRW 40,909,331 thousand, US KRW 26,943,686 thousand, Japan KRW 16,123,244 thousand (nil in H1 2025), China KRW 7,196,585 thousand, other KRW 3,503,558 thousand. Two customers each above 10% of consolidated revenue: KRW 12,869,224 thousand and KRW 10,482,295 thousand; parent top three customers (undisclosed) were 21%, 17% and 13% of KRW 62,126 million.
quarterly_data.figure: Services 87% / mass production 13% of ASIC revenue; Japan KRW 16,123,244 thousand (from nil); top customer KRW 12,869,224 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: Foundry channels and suppliers: SemiFive works as a Samsung Foundry DSP (it says it is the only Samsung Foundry DSP with a sales base in China, where demand to use Samsung processes has surged, while watching US export controls) and as a GlobalFoundries platinum partner, with a Global Fab BU also serving SMIC-process customers; it targets the US, China and Japan and reports visible results in Japan. H1 2026 outsourced processing and service purchases were KRW 44,124 million (domestic KRW 28,958 million, imports KRW 15,166 million). Related-party purchases in H1 2026: Doosan Tesna (chip test) KRW 1,658,581 thousand and largest shareholder SiFive (RISC-V IP) KRW 488,132 thousand.
quarterly_data.figure: Outsourced processing purchases KRW 44,124 million; Doosan Tesna purchases KRW 1,658,581 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: R&D roadmap in the report: a chiplet-based 4nm AI HPC platform using UCIe die-to-die links, Arm Neoverse N2 with a mesh bus and LPDDR6; a 4nm AI HPC platform adopting LPDDR5X for 512GB/s memory bandwidth, twice the GDDR6 used in its 5nm HPC platform; an 8nm AI platform with vertically stacked 3D DRAM using TSV and hybrid bonding; a second-generation 14nm AI inference platform; PCIe Gen6 interface IP planned. SemiFive is registered as an Arm Total Design partner for Neoverse-based custom silicon. It plans a US R&D centre for chiplet technology and is adding logic engineers in India and physical-design engineers in Vietnam. H1 2026 R&D expense KRW 8,716 million (14.03% of revenue) with 55 researchers.
quarterly_data.figure: 4nm LPDDR5X platform 512GB/s; H1 R&D KRW 8,716 million (14.03% of revenue)
